Tag Generation Algorithm

How the agricultural tag generator processes your field labels

Processing Steps

  1. 1. Text Normalization: Convert to lowercase, remove punctuation
  2. 2. Tokenization: Split into individual words
  3. 3. Stop Word Removal: Filter out common words (built-in list)
  4. 4. Lemmatization: Convert to standardized word forms
  5. 5. Word Significance Ranking: Prioritize agricultural terms
  6. 6. Word Selection: Choose top 2-3 meaningful words
  7. 7. Formatting: Apply snake_case formatting
  8. 8. Uniqueness Check: Ensure tag uniqueness (timestamp-based)

Example Transformations

Input: "What is the breadth of your pen?"

Output: pen_breadth

Input: "Chick vaccination date"

Output: chick_vaccination

Input: "Soil pH level measurement"

Output: soil_ph
